verdict.rationale: Muse is an autonomous agent with its own computer and terminal. Its docs describe completing tasks on the web: purchasing 'across the internet' with one-time Link cards, saving your logins to a credential store, finding deals, and booking whole trips. That implies it acts on websites for you, but no evidence explicitly says it drives a web browser, so the browser capability is inferred rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of browser automation or web navigation, any detail on how web research and form-filling work, and independent or hands-on corroboration of website task completion.
